items.title: Scaling a Weaviate vector index 26× with one Amazon EBS gp3 command
items.summary: Weaviate took a 10-million-vector HFresh vector index from 9.8 to 260 queries per second, a 26.5x throughput gain with no re-indexing and no added RAM, by raising one Amazon EBS gp3 volume from 3,000 to 80,000 IOPS with a single API call.
items.creator: Spiros Andreou
